items.title: The Dark Side of AI: Four Things Worth Building in Diabetes Care
items.summary: How can AI remove work from diabetes care without creating new risks for patients? Shahid Shah examines four possibilities: better-prepared visits, care between visits, one shared care plan and agreed tasks completed across organizations.Using research findings and illustrative scenarios, the presentation examines missing information in polished summaries, alerts without an owner, conflicting recommendations and errors that spread across connected systems. It distinguishes AI functions and the evidence each requires, with practical proposals for verification, human oversight, training, bounded authority and recovery when systems fail.Presented at Diabetes Technology Meeting, October 27, 2026. Timelines are conditional scenarios; proposed roles for ADA and DTS are not adopted standards or commitments.https://shahidshah.com
